notes:
REF-BM-02: Collects title, description, and favicon, but not a preview image.
REF-BM-06: Duplicate URLs are rejected and the existing ID is returned, but the UI does not guide the user into editing that bookmark.
REF-BM-11: Exact tag filtering exists in the API/URL state, but displayed tags are not selectable as filters.
REF-BM-19: Mark-as-read persists, but an item remains visible in the active unread view until the collection reloads.
REF-BM-20: No multi-selection or bulk-action controls exist.
REF-BM-21: No whole-filtered-collection bulk action exists.
REF-BM-22: Results use a fixed newest-first order with no selectable sort key.
REF-BM-23: Notes can be written and edited, but are neither displayed nor rendered as Markdown.
REF-BM-24: No local HTML/PDF snapshot storage exists.
REF-BM-25: No Internet Archive snapshot support exists.
REF-BM-26: No archive state or default-list exclusion exists.
REF-BM-27: Permanent deletion exists, but there is no reversible archive operation to distinguish from it.
REF-BM-28: No archived-bookmarks view exists.
REF-BM-29: No bundle entity or saved-filter workflow exists.
REF-BM-30: No Netscape HTML import exists.
REF-BM-31: No Netscape HTML export exists.
REF-BM-32: No personal display settings exist.
